title: Every Way Through the Maze
statement:
A grid has open cells `.` and walls `#`. You start in the top-left cell and want to reach the bottom-right cell. Each step moves to a side-adjacent open cell (up, down, left or right). You may not enter the same cell twice, and the walk ends the moment you reach the bottom-right cell. Count the different walks.

If the grid is a single cell, the start is the end, and there is exactly one (empty) walk.

## Input
The first line contains `n` and `m`. Each of the next `n` lines is a string of `m` characters.

## Output
Print the number of different walks. The top-left and bottom-right cells are always open.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n, m <= 5`
